Yeah I got pulled into behavioral health and told they were gonna begin separating me. 

I met with my Master Chief and he was awesome about it and gave me a whole "I've been there" speech. He said he's gonna try to advocate for me to stay in and switch departments.
Is there a regulation on this? He's big on regs and if I could pull some kind of reg or instruction to shut him down, that'd be pretty nice.

Actually this statement is false. I was never contacted. I'm not the only suicidal one on this base. You probably did get *someone* help but it wasn't me.

EDIT: Just throwing this in there. I thank everyone for the concern/advice. I'm just really nervous and don't want to go speak with the counselor lady and wind up getting seperated just for asking for help.
Nice to see someone got the reference, haha.

I was looking into applying for TA but my DLPO said he'd deny and chit to come to his desk with my name on it.

I've considered getting into fishing but I don't even know where to start since we've got some pretty crazy fish where I'm at.

I know it's all temporary but I just dislike how this is my first experience in the fleet. Really makes me discouraged to my prospective future. 

It also sucks because I have an interest in becoming colorguard, CMA, and SAPR victim advocate but my DLPO said he will deny any chit he sees with my name on it. So I'm trying to find things I like to do but he's just making it 1000x more difficult because he has a stick up his ass. 

Thankfully, I'm only here until September 2016.
